h: פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי מוֹת, ח׳ Acharei Mos, 8
Shabbos Makes the Heart a Field of Divine Blessing

p: of the holy Field of Apples."
This is according to what they said:
"'She has hewn out her seven pillars' (Mishlei 9:1):
these are the seven days of Creation"
which are the seven lower attributes;
and the seventh attribute, the attribute of Malchus,
is the purpose of the making of heaven and earth,
that they recognize the yoke of His kingship.
And even though on the sixth day we say
the main recognition of the Kingdom of Heaven
and sat on His Throne of Glory."
This is along the lines of what they said
"'Your throne is established from of old' (Tehillim 93:2):
a parable of a king, etc.:
what difference in honor is there
between the king and the augustus?
Rather, the king stands on the platform,
but as it were You were standing,
but from when You stood at the sea
and we said song before You
And this is along the lines of what they said
"They are the ones who first made Me king at the sea,
ה׳ יִמְלוֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד (שְׁמוֹת טו, יח)
for then His kingship was settled,
for there was a complete nation
that accepted the yoke of His kingship.
so that there be the nation of Yisrael
to accept the yoke of His kingship,
He "sat on His Throne of Glory";
and then is the completeness of the attribute of Malchus.
וְיִתְרוֹן אֶרֶץ בַּכֹּל הִיא (קֹהֶלֶת ה, ח)
"'And the advantage of the land is in everything' (Koheles 5:8):
and benefit to the world, etc.
This is 'the field that Hashem has blessed,'
כְּרֵיחַ שָׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרְכוֹ ה׳ וְכוּלֵּי
'like the fragrance of a field that Hashem has blessed,'" etc.
corresponding to which is the day of Shabbos,
of it is written, "And God blessed
for from the beginning of Creation
"to work it and to guard it" (2:15),
for then the Creation was meant
for the Shechinah to dwell chiefly below;
the place of the dwelling of the Shechinah remained
in the place of the Mikdash,
and was given to the kohanim,
that they be the ones who work it;
it remained in time, in the day of Shabbos,
as it says in the holy Zohar
One who makes for them a dwelling on Shabbos
in the two chambers of the heart," etc.
And Shabbos is called "a worked field."
this is the Holy One, blessed be He;
'Tziyon will be plowed as a field.'"
For Tziyon is the name for
it was taught according to the one who says,
"from Tziyon the world was created," etc.,
"From Tziyon, the perfection of beauty," etc.:
"the perfection of the beauty of the world";
is in the Holy of Holies.
that the completeness of the attribute of Malchus
which is the attribute of tzaddik,
And it is written in the gloss on the holy Zohar
that "kol" is the numerical value of fifty,
and when it joins with the hei,
and this is "when it is rectified
And this is "and the advantage of the land,"
for "land" is the name of the attribute of Malchus:
for the main service from the person's side is
"What does Hashem your God ask of you
and this is Binah, the heart,
"then you will understand the fear of Hashem."
And tzaddik is the attribute of yirah,
אֶת הָאֱלֹקִים אֲנִי יָרֵא (בְּרֵאשִׁית מב, יח)
and the attribute of yirah is called heart,
עַל מִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
about one who has no yiras Shamayim,
and the completeness of the attribute of Malchus
is in its joining with the attribute of tzaddik,
And this is what it said,
even though it is written in Sefer HaBahir,
from there all the souls fly forth,"
which is from the attribute of Malchus,
which is called the bond of life.
it is written, "And she gives food to her household
and a portion to her maidens" (Mishlei 31:15),
which is something engraved and allotted,
And this is only when she receives
(as they said in Midrash Rabbah, Parshas Chukas);
And so the souls of Yisrael,
through her receiving from the attribute of Yesod.
which is the attribute of yirah,
when the shelter of peace is spread,
to make for her a beautiful dwelling, etc.,
"this is the revelation of the Shechinah";
from where all the souls fly forth.
וְזֶהוּ וַתָּקָם בְּעוֹד לַיְלָה (מִשְׁלֵי לא, טו)
And this is "She rises while it is still night" (Mishlei 31:15),
for night is the name of the Shechinah:
for day is the Holy One, blessed be He,
"and she gives food to her household."
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar (II 88a):
so that his table be blessed, etc.,
which is "the field that Hashem has blessed"

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Bamidbar 35:34 — “ולא תטמא את הארץ אשר אתם ישבים בה אשר אני שכן בתוכה כי אני יהוה שכן בתוך בני ישראל” — “You shall not defile the land in which you live, in which I Myself abide, for I יהוה abide among the Israelite people.”
